description:
The Aqua MODIS (Moderate resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) Level-1A (L1A) Geolocation product contains geodetic coordinates, ground elevation, and solar and satellite zenith and azimuth angles for the center of each MODIS 1-km pixel at nadir. These data serve as a companion dataset to the Level-1B calibrated radiances (MYD02) and the higher-level products to enable further processing. These geolocation fields are determined using data inputs from the spacecraft attitude and orbit, instrument telemetry, and a digital elevation model.

This document describes the version 7.0 (v7.0) of the Aqua MODIS 1-km Geolocation product whose short-name is MYD03. It represents the most current version of this product that has undergone around half-a-dozen reprocessing cycles in the last 2.5 decades. Each 1-km swath granule or data-file temporally spans 5 minutes, and its nominal image dimensions measure 2,030 lines (along-track direction) by 1,354 samples (cross-track direction). The v7.0 collection’s data record starts from February 24, 2000 (2000–055).

The following Science Data Sets (SDS) describe the range of information provided for each 1-km pixel’s Instantaneous Field of View (IFOV). A range of other information attributes (quality, offsets, observation start-time, etc.) exist as well. 


| SDS Variable | Long Name |
|-------------|-----------|
| Latitude | Latitude |
| Latitude_500m | Latitude (500m) |
| Longitude | Longitude |
| Longitude_500m | Longitude (500m) |
|  |  |
#### Data Fields

| SDS Variable | Long Name |
|-------------|-----------|
| gflags | gflags |
| Height | Height |
| Height_Offset | Height Offset |
| Height_500m | Height (500m) |
| Land-Sea Mask | Land-Sea Mask |
| Range | Range |
| Scan Offset | Scan Offset |
| Sensor Azimuth | Sensor Azimuth |
| Sensor Zenith | Sensor Zenith |
| Solar Azimuth | Solar Azimuth |
| Solar Zenith | Solar Zenith |
| Track Offset | Track Offset |
| Water Present | Water Present |


- Added a new solar-eclipse flag.
- Added 500-m information for the geodetic latitude, longitude, and height variables.
- Revised the practice of using a yearly updated Land-Water Mask database instead of a static database.
- Refreshed the Ground Control Point (GCP) chip library:
  - Expanded the number of chips from 1,214 to 2,514.
  - Extended chip coverage from 24 × 24 km to 42 × 42 km.
  - Extended error measurements from scan angles of ±45° to ±55°.
  - Extended error searches from an area of ±0.8 to ±2.5 250-m pixels.
  - Increased the cross-correlation coefficient threshold from 0.6 to 0.85.
title: MODIS/Aqua Geolocation Fields 5-Min L1A Swath 1km V7
